title: Sub Confession
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A slow-burn, bass-led dance-pop cut where a rolling 808 sub is the hook. Broken-kick groove and crisp syncopated hats build under chopped vocal stabs and a bright plucky lead, swelling into a glossy euphoric chorus before stripping back to a felt-piano breakdown and a second, bigger lift.
